title.en: Build a processor with replaceable kernels

t.zh: 三点加权能处理一条线，但斜向和其他形状需要更一般的邻域。工具把重复取样展开为表，你把刚才学会的加权关系扩展到整张权重表。工具不会替你加权求和。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A line cannot express every diagonal or local pattern. A helper unfolds repeated sampling into tables. Extend the weighted relation to the entire table; the helper does not calculate a weighted sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 一台加权处理器能复用不同核。核不翻转、书写位置直接对应邻域时，得到互相关。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
after.en: One weighted processor reuses different kernels. Written-order weights matched directly to neighbours compute correlation. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 造一个接受任意奇数尺寸权重表的局部处理器。展开邻域只给读数和权重；你负责组合它们，并为每个原位置得到一个结果。
brief.en: Build a local processor accepting any odd-sized weight table. Unfold windows supplies samples and weights only; combine them and produce one result per original location.

naiveWhy.zh: 权重已经给出贡献，额外平均会再除以邻域格数；常量和单位核会揭示错误。
naiveWhy.en: The weights already specify contributions. Averaging divides again by window size; constant and identity cases expose it.

hint.zh: 每行是一处输出的邻域。先检查读数与权重的对应，再决定如何把一行变成一个结果。
hint.en: Each row is one output neighbourhood. Inspect sample/weight correspondence, then decide how to reduce the row.

desc.zh: 将权重表直接对齐邻域并求加权和。运行你自己的电路，图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Compute written-order weighted neighbourhood sums using your circuit, with explicit borders.
